question: WPT serves .xht/.xhtml/.xml as application/xhtml+xml, so Chrome parses them as XML. Port step 08 parses every vellora document as HTML. How many reftests change outcome if the harness feeds .xht nodes to that HTML parse (option b) instead of keeping an XML parse for them (option a)?

census.note: every node (test + references) of the 8047 reftests, with the PREPARED html vellora receives (fidelity/wpt/lib/prepare.mjs); sniff = what blitz-html 0.3.0-beta.4 HtmlDocument::from_html chose at step 07

optionB_htmlForEveryNode.command: node fidelity/wpt/run.mjs --xhtml-parser html --out fidelity/results/wpt-08-measure-html-everywhere --expectations fidelity/baselines/port/07-media-print/wpt/expectations-blitz-0.3.0-beta.4.json --chrome-from ~/.cache/vellora-fidelity/run-all-beta4-20261021T054809Z/wpt/results.json (run before --xhtml-parser existed, on the step-08 core with the step-07 harness, which is the same thing: renderPdf for every node)

gatedRun.note: the WPT step of run-all 08-html-parse (the committed baseline): --xhtml-parser xml (default); 0 outcome transitions against step 07, 8047 unchanged (gate-report.json has no WPT item)

choice.why: option (b) changes 1695 outcomes (1474 clean passes lost) and every changed test has a CDATA section, i.e. it measures the HTML parser on XML input that Chrome never sees as HTML; option (a) changes none. The XML parse is reachable only from fidelity tooling (vellora_core::debug_render_xhtml, #[doc(hidden)], run by crates/vellora-core/examples/xhtml_render.rs); renderPdf, @vellora/native and the CLI are unchanged.
choice.harnessSemantics: unchanged (2): HARNESS_SEMANTICS versions the verdict rules for a given rendering (lib/provenance.mjs); this changes the rendering of XML-served nodes, and Chrome's side is untouched, so Chrome reuse (--chrome-from) stays valid

sniffMissNodes.note: the 7 .xht nodes blitz-html's sniff parsed as HTML at step 07 (`<!DOCTYPE html>` first, then <html xmlns>), now parsed as XML like Chrome: the only nodes whose parser differs from step 07 under option (a). Their 5 tests keep their outcome; two failing tests change their differing-pixel count (HYPOTHESIS: Blitz's table layout of the XML DOM's table>tr, which has no implied tbody)
